html:
Between 1277 and 1301 armies of Kublai Khan's Yuan dynasty invaded Burma from Yunnan. The Pagan king had refused to pay tribute and had executed Mongol envoys.

The Mongols won at Ngasaunggyan in 1277, and in 1287 the Pagan empire collapsed. The king fled and was later murdered. Mongol troops reached the plains but did not stay long.

Burma broke into pieces: the Shan in the north, the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy in the south, and Ava in the centre. Only in the 16th century did Taungoo reunite it. Compare the Mongol invasion of Java.
